summary: Builds a level-of-detail cache for drawing an input object at reduced detail based on camera distance without directly changing the source geometry.
common_gotchas: LOD SOP is not a replacement for Polyreduce SOP when downstream reduced geometry is needed.
Triangulation matters because reduction works on triangles.
The second input is rest geometry for reduction, not an arbitrary blend target.
key_concepts: LOD SOP builds a draw cache for level-of-detail display rather than emitting reduced geometry in the SOP stream.
Cache selection is based on camera distance thresholds and reduction percentages.
An optional second input can provide rest geometry for expensive polygon reduction while the first input supplies points.
Reduction requires triangles, and `polysonly` limits affected geometry types.
